versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes or file modifications in this release.  
(No changes detected from previous version.)

Initial release of Crypto Market Analyst — comprehensive crypto insights via Finskills API.

- Retrieves and analyzes real-time and historical data for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and major altcoins.
- Provides structured market regime classification (bull/bear status, halving cycle phase, volatility).
- Computes key metrics: total market cap, Bitcoin/Ethereum/altcoin dominance, ATH distances, altcoin season index.
- Offers actionable guidance and context-driven sentiment assessment.
- Output formatted as a clear, digestible Crypto Market Report.
